notes.title: Patch Notes for "Let Me Out" 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Mac OS Support
[/list]"Let Me Out" is now available on Mac OS. Enjoy the game on your Mac with a native build.
[list][*] Steam Cloud Integration
[/list]Your progress can now be saved using Steam Cloud. You can continue your adventure seamlessly across different devices.

[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[b]Steam Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*] Dad's Secret: Fixed an issue where this achievement was not unlocking upon completing Chapter 2.
[*] Still There: Resolved a problem with this achievement for going AFK for 1 hour not being awarded correctly.
[*] Spider Whisperer: Fixed the achievement for controlling Poko for a total of 2 hours.
[*] Nightmare Conqueror: Corrected the issue where the achievement for completing the game without dying was not being granted.
[/list]
[b]Chapter 1: Jane[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the wardrobe in the sister's room was incorrectly highlighted.
[*] Fixed the 3D lamp petromax in the kitchen, which was standing out unnaturally.
[*] Moved the "interact" action (F button) from the ship toy to the spider cage on the desk.
[/list][b]Chapter 2: Alvin's House[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Jane would not disappear after the dialogue.
[/list]
[b]Chapter 4: Underground[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the selection area for the generator, making it easier to interact with.
[/list]
[b]Dialogue and Cutscenes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Jane's eye material was still visible during the ending cutscene with the parents.
[/list]
[b]Adjusted and balanced the SFX for the following cutscenes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cutscene KerisComeOut in Chapter 7.
[*] Cutscene SeeMomTimeline in Chapter 7.
[*] Cutscene JanePickupKeris in Chapter 8.
[/list]
[b]Localization[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Main Menu option button panel for German localization, correcting "Einstellung en" to "Einstellungen."
[/list]

Thank you for your support and have fun!

notes.title: Let Me Out - Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the neutralized potion requirements item in chapter 6 not being able to be picked up again after running out of potions and wanting to make more
[*] Fixed spider not spawning when loading to chapter 8, instead Alvin spawning
[*] Fixed collider bug in chapter 3 and chapter 6
[*] Fixed indicator UI sometimes not matching interactions
[/list]

[b]Adjustment[/b]
[list]
[*] Set default mouse sensitivity to lower
[*] Rock cannot be enhanced before their time
[/list]

Please make sure you got the latest update with BuildID 15449215.

You might force an update by verifying the integrity of your Let Me Out installation.

We hope you enjoy Let Me Out.

notes.title: Let Me Out - Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Dad Journal Bug when the player gets a new page, the page sometimes doubles or even disappears from inventory.
[*] Fixed Sometimes players can't switch character to spider (poko)
[*] Fixed Begu AI Stuck when walking through obstacles
[*] Fixed Camera glitch when switching character to spider (poko)
[*] Fixed Item inventory not being reset when finishing credits and creating a new story slot
[/list]

[b]Adjustment[/b]
[list]
[*] Decrease Alarm Audio SFX volume when interact dialogue mode
[*] Remove the Doppler Effect on alarm audio that causes annoying sounds
[*] Change radio sound effect
[/list]
